nodes.summary: Sets whose h-fold sums cover the integers or a group: asymptotic, exact and restricted bases, Schnirelmann density, Rohrbach's theorem, representation counts and convolutions, sums of cubes covering vector spaces, knight-move bases of the plane, and sumsets of infinite sets of positive or zero density.
nodes.title: Additive bases

nodes.summary: Comparison of |A+A| with |A−A|: sum-dominant (MSTD) and difference-dominated sets, minimal MSTD and MPTQ sets, Chu's constructions, unions of progressions, and the single-set sum-difference exponent.
nodes.title: Sets with more sums than differences

nodes.summary: Density versions: Szemerédi's and Roth's theorems and Roth-number bounds, Sárközy's theorem, cap sets, counts of three-term progressions, progressions in complements and in walks, arithmetic progression API, and polynomial triangle removal in vector spaces.
nodes.title: Arithmetic progressions in dense sets

nodes.summary: Sidon and B_h-sets (bounds, counts, greedy and thick constructions, isolated sums, the Sidon ideal), Golomb rulers, difference bases, cyclic and perfect difference sets including Singer's theorem, and difference sets of sparse sets.
nodes.title: Sidon sets and difference sets

nodes.summary: Sets with no solution to x+y=z or similar: sum-free sets in abelian groups and intervals, counts of sum-free and maximal sum-free sets, large sum-free subsets, square-sum-free, divisor-sum-free and non-averaging sets.
nodes.title: Sum-free sets

nodes.summary: Size and structure of A+B, hA and restricted or signed sumsets: Cauchy–Davenport and Vosper, Freiman-type and polynomial Freiman–Ruzsa theorems, small doubling, sums of dilates, h-fold sumsets with distinct terms, rectification, sets determined by k-sums, max-min (lunar) decompositions, and sum-product and product-set growth.
nodes.title: Sumsets and inverse theorems

nodes.summary: Davenport and weighted Davenport constants, zero-sum subsequences and cross numbers, Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv-type results, perfect subset-sum covers, zero subset sums and balanced subset sums in finite abelian groups, and subset sums with bounded numbers of terms.
nodes.title: Zero-sum problems and subset sums

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
